arguments.sql:
WITH club_history AS (
    SELECT a.team_api_id, MAX(a.date) FILTER (WHERE a.date < '2014-09-20') AS latest_date
    FROM main.Team_Attributes AS a
    GROUP BY a.team_api_id
    HAVING MAX(a.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky') = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS joined_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_api_id) AS clubs,
       COUNT(a.date) AS dated_rows, COUNT(a.chanceCreationPassing) AS scored_rows,
       MIN(a.date) AS earliest_snapshot, MAX(a.date) AS latest_snapshot,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT typeof(a.chanceCreationPassing)) AS score_types
FROM club_history AS h
JOIN main.Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = h.team_api_id
LEFT JOIN main.Team_Attributes AS a
  ON a.team_api_id = h.team_api_id AND a.date = h.latest_date

arguments.sql:
WITH eligible_clubs AS (
    SELECT a.team_api_id,
           MAX(a.date) FILTER (WHERE a.date < '2014-09-20') AS latest_date
    FROM main.Team_Attributes AS a
    GROUP BY a.team_api_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky') > 0
)
SELECT t.team_short_name,
       COUNT(*) AS club_count,
       ROUND(AVG(a.chanceCreationPassing), 1) AS average_passing_risk
FROM eligible_clubs AS c
JOIN main.Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = c.team_api_id
LEFT JOIN main.Team_Attributes AS a
       ON a.team_api_id = c.team_api_id AND a.date = c.latest_date
GROUP BY t.team_short_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY average_passing_risk DESC, t.team_short_name ASC
